notes: Money flow: when Settings names the people behind the paychecks, the diagram gains a layer - each paycheck source on the far left flows into its person, and the people flow into Income (sources nobody is named for still flow straight in). Cash that crosses between the bank and the investment accounts is now drawn both ways: 'From investments' arrives on the left of Income, 'To investments' leaves on the right, in the same blue, so money pulled out and put back reads as a round trip; the summary line says what the bank accounts actually ended up or down once those transfers are counted. The investment row's 'Put in' and 'Taken out' blocks say how much of each was the bank side of those same transfers. Fix: Income report person rows lined up with the month columns.
